description: client/option-defaults.json: what a public option of a Xynolog client is when its caller leaves it out, where the client, not the service, decides.

method.description: What takes the option, as client/surface.json names it: a namespace's method, or a module's function, the two joined by a dot.

parameter.description: The parameter it is, or the parameter whose member it is.

option.description: The member of the parameter it is, where the parameter is an object of options. Absent: the parameter itself.

value.$comment: What the client takes when the caller leaves it out: JSON, of the option's schema.

sends.description: Where in the request the method sends it, as a JSON Pointer into a case's `sends`. Absent: the option is not sent, and only changes what the client does.

docs.description: What the option is, in prose.
